verdict.rationale: Anrok's docs confirm it collects and validates customer tax IDs per jurisdiction and resolves addresses for tax jurisdiction determination (anrok-docs-10, anrok-docs-25, anrok-docs-38, anrok-docs-11), which supports B2B tax ID handling, but there is no explicit documentation of real-time validation against official VAT registries (e.g., VIES) or of reverse-charge logic being automatically applied for cross-border B2B transactions. missing for 10: explicit registry-validation (e.g., VIES) integration, explicit reverse-charge mechanism/documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of cross-border B2B correctness.
